text: This report is filed regarding suspicious activity in the account of Bilal Latif (CNIC 420201-5554581-1), a freelance software developer with a declared monthly income of PKR 90,000. Between May 1 and May 9, 2026, the account received 11 inbound IBFT transfers totaling PKR 632,000 from nine distinct counterparties, including Hamid Rehman, Saad Zafar, and Junaid Akhtar. This volume is significantly inconsistent with the customer's declared income and occupation. The activity exhibits classic mule characteristics: funds were rapidly swept out of the account via two wallet transfers to QuickPay wallet ***0932 (PKR 147,000 on May 9 and PKR 43,000 on May 11) and a large ATM withdrawal of PKR 135,000 at an ATM in Islamabad on May 11. The customer resides in Karachi, making the out-of-city cash withdrawal suspicious. The pattern of receiving multiple small-to-medium transfers from unrelated parties and immediately moving the funds to digital wallets or cash suggests the account is being used to layer illicit funds, potentially for money laundering or terrorist financing. No legitimate business rationale for this high-velocity, high-volume activity has been identified.
